title: •Scrambled Transmission
caption: •Scrambled Transmission (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. Unless you have 13 or more cards in hand, opponent may not peek at or remove those cards (except with Monnok). Once per turn, may ▲ Logistical Delay, peek at a card placed face-down by You’re A Slave?, or lose 2 Force to cancel a Political Effect. {alter}
lore: The Rebel Alliance employs sophisticated jamming technology to block Imperial communications.
